pages.title: Selection Chamber
pages.text: A bank of cultures under a pressure that only the fittest survive, generation after generation.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the selection strength s and the population size N. A good trait fixes with chance (1 - e^(-2s)) / (1 - e^(-4Ns)), which must reach the recipe's level; weak selection (4Ns under 1) is lost to drift, and too strong a pressure (s over 0.5) kills the culture.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Evolved Strain, Omnicellular Genome.
